source: arXiv:2508.14656 — Yuqi Luan (2025). Deep Learning for Short-Term Equity Trend Forecasting: A Behavior-Driven Multi-Factor Approach.
title: H294 — Behavioral Multi-Factor MLP (40 Behavioral Factors, 5-Day Horizon)
rationale: Luan (2025) proposes a dual-task MLP combining 40 behavioral finance-derived factors (momentum herding proxies, volume-price divergence measures, bottom-reversal signals, and TA indicators) with a joint regression+classification objective for 5-day equity return prediction. Key innovation: jointly predicts returns AND direction, using the classification head's directional signal to rank stocks cross-sectionally. Reported improvement over linear factor models via IC/IR metrics. This naturally extends H217 (alpha101, monthly rebalance, OOS Sharpe 1.559) by: (1) adding behavioral factor inputs beyond the single alpha101 signal; (2) using a shorter 5-day prediction horizon; (3) employing a direction-aware training objective. The 40 factors align with what we can compute from OHLCV data: alpha101 (H217), MACD/RSI/Stoch/ROC (H233 feature set), IBS (H112 family), volume-price ratio (H216), and new behavioral signals (herding proxy = rolling rank correlation between volume and prior return). IS: 2013-2020, OOS: 2021-2026, gate: OOS Sharpe > H217 baseline (1.559). Universe: 30 large-cap (same as H217). Weekly rebalance to capture 5-day horizon.
content:
Script scaffold for H294: Behavioral Multi-Factor MLP (5-day horizon).

Hypothesis:
  Luan (2025) arXiv:2508.14656. 40 behavioral factors + dual-task MLP
  (joint regression + direction classification) outperforms alpha101 alone.

Factor groups (compute from OHLCV via yfinance):
  Group A — Intraday structure (alpha101 family):
    alpha101 = (close - open) / (0.001 + high - low), clipped [-1,1]
    intraday_range = (high - low) / close
    close_position = (close - low) / (high - low)  # = IBS

  Group B — Volume-price behavioral signals:
    vol_price_diverge = rank(pct_change(volume,1)) - rank(pct_change(close,1))
    money_flow = volume * (2*close - high - low) / (high - low)
    volume_trend = pct_change(volume.rolling(5).mean(), 21)

  Group C — Momentum herding proxy:
    herd_5d = rolling_corr(volume, returns_1d, window=10)  # high = herding
    ret_5d = pct_change(close, 5)
    ret_21d = pct_change(close, 21)
    ret_63d = pct_change(close, 63)

  Group D — Bottom-reversal signals:
    distance_52w_low = close / rolling_min(close, 252)
    rsi_14 = RSI(close, 14)
    mean_reversion_5d = -ret_5d  # contrarian short-term

  Group E — TA indicators (from H233 feature pipeline):
    MACD line, MACD histogram, RSI, Stochastic %K/%D, ROC

Model:
  StandardScaler per feature across cross-section
  MLP: input(40) → hidden(64) → hidden(32) → [return_output(1), direction_output(1)]
  Loss: 0.5 * MSE(return) + 0.5 * BCEWithLogits(direction)
  Train on IS (2013-2020); freeze; predict OOS (2021-2026)
  Rank stocks by 0.5*predicted_return_rank + 0.5*direction_prob; long top-6
  Weekly rebalance (Friday close → Monday open).

Gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.559 (H217 baseline)
